```{r}
# ── 1a. Raw price distribution ────────────────────────────────────────────────
p1a <- ggplot(data, aes(x = price)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 100, fill = "#2C7BB6", colour = "white", alpha = 0.85) +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = scales::comma,
                     limits = c(0, quantile(data$price, 0.99))) +
  labs(title = "Distribution of Sale Prices — London 2018-2025",
       subtitle = "Capped at 99th percentile for visualisation",
       x = "Sale Price (£)", y = "Count")

# ── 1b. Log price distribution ────────────────────────────────────────────────
p1b <- ggplot(data, aes(x = log(price))) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 100, fill = "#D7191C", colour = "white", alpha = 0.85) +
  labs(title = "Distribution of Log Sale Prices — London 2018-2025",
       x = "Log Sale Price", y = "Count")

# ── 1c. EPC efficiency distribution ──────────────────────────────────────────
p1c <- ggplot(data, aes(x = current_energy_efficiency)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 50, fill = "#1A9641", colour = "white", alpha = 0.85) +
  labs(title = "Distribution of Current Energy Efficiency",
       x = "Energy Efficiency Score", y = "Count")

# ── 1d. Floor area distribution ───────────────────────────────────────────────
p1d <- ggplot(data, aes(x = total_floor_area)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 80, fill = "#756BB1", colour = "white", alpha = 0.85) +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = scales::comma) +
  labs(title = "Distribution of Total Floor Area",
       x = "Floor Area (m²)", y = "Count")

# ── 1e. Distance to tube distribution ────────────────────────────────────────
p1e <- ggplot(data, aes(x = dist_to_tube_km)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 80, fill = "#F46D43", colour = "white", alpha = 0.85) +
  labs(title = "Distribution of Distance to Nearest TfL Station",
       x = "Distance (km)", y = "Count")

# ── 1f. Transaction volume by year ────────────────────────────────────────────
p1f <- data %>%
  mutate(year = lubridate::year(date_of_transfer)) %>%
  count(year) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = factor(year), y = n)) +
  geom_col(fill = "#2C7BB6", alpha = 0.85) +
  geom_text(aes(label = scales::comma(n)), vjust = -0.5, size = 3) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::comma) +
  labs(title = "Transaction Volume by Year — London 2018-2025",
       x = "Year", y = "Number of Transactions")

# ── Print all ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
print(p1a)
print(p1b)
print(p1c)
print(p1d)
print(p1e)
print(p1f)

# ── Save all ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
ggsave("eda_plots/01a_price_distribution.png",          p1a, width=10, height=6, dpi=300)
ggsave("eda_plots/01b_log_price_distribution.png",      p1b, width=10, height=6, dpi=300)
ggsave("eda_plots/01c_epc_efficiency_distribution.png", p1c, width=10, height=6, dpi=300)
ggsave("eda_plots/01d_floor_area_distribution.png",     p1d, width=10, height=6, dpi=300)
ggsave("eda_plots/01e_dist_tube_distribution.png",      p1e, width=10, height=6, dpi=300)
ggsave("eda_plots/01f_transaction_volume_year.png",     p1f, width=10, height=6, dpi=300)

cat("Section 1 complete ✓\n")
```

```{r}
# ── 2a. Price vs EPC Efficiency (scatterplot with smoother) ───────────────────
p2a <- ggplot(data %>% sample_n(50000), 
              aes(x = current_energy_efficiency, y = log(price))) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.1, colour = "#2C7BB6", size = 0.8) +
  geom_smooth(method = "loess", colour = "#D7191C", se = TRUE) +
  labs(title = "Log Price vs Current Energy Efficiency",
       subtitle = "Sample of 50,000 transactions",
       x = "Energy Efficiency Score", y = "Log Sale Price (£)")

# ── 2b. Price vs Property Type (boxplot) ─────────────────────────────────────
p2b <- ggplot(data, aes(x = reorder(property_type, price, median), 
                                 y = log(price), fill = property_type)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.85) +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set2") +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(title = "Log Price by Property Type",
       x = "", y = "Log Sale Price (£)") +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

# ── 2c. Price vs Construction Age Band (boxplot) ──────────────────────────────
age_order <- c("Before 1919", "1919-1929", "1930-1949", "1950-1966",
               "1967-1975", "1976-1982", "1983-1990", "1991-1995",
               "1996-2002", "2003-2006", "2007-2011", "2012 onwards")

p2c <- ggplot(data %>% 
                mutate(construction_age_band = factor(construction_age_band, 
                                                       levels = age_order)),
              aes(x = construction_age_band, y = log(price), 
                  fill = construction_age_band)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.85) +
  scale_fill_viridis_d() +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(title = "Log Price by Construction Age Band",
       x = "", y = "Log Sale Price (£)") +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

# ── 2d. Price vs Floor Level (boxplot) ────────────────────────────────────────
floor_order <- c("Basement", "Ground", "Floor 1-3", 
                 "Floor 4-6", "Floor 7-9", "Floor 10+", "Unknown")

p2d <- ggplot(data %>%
                mutate(floor_level = factor(floor_level, levels = floor_order)),
              aes(x = floor_level, y = log(price), fill = floor_level)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.85) +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "RdYlBu") +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(title = "Log Price by Floor Level",
       x = "", y = "Log Sale Price (£)") +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

# ── 2e. Price vs Distance to Tube (scatterplot with smoother) ─────────────────
p2e <- ggplot(data %>% sample_n(50000),
              aes(x = dist_to_tube_km, y = log(price))) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.1, colour = "#F46D43", size = 0.8) +
  geom_smooth(method = "loess", colour = "#1A9641", se = TRUE) +
  labs(title = "Log Price vs Distance to Nearest TfL Station",
       subtitle = "Sample of 50,000 transactions",
       x = "Distance to TfL Station (km)", y = "Log Sale Price (£)")

# ── 2f. Price vs Built Form (boxplot) ─────────────────────────────────────────
p2f <- ggplot(data, aes(x = reorder(built_form, price, median),
                                 y = log(price), fill = built_form)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.85) +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set3") +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(title = "Log Price by Built Form",
       x = "", y = "Log Sale Price (£)") +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

# ── 2g. Price vs District (ranked bar chart) ──────────────────────────────────
p2g <- data %>%
  group_by(district) %>%
  summarise(median_price = median(price), .groups = "drop") %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = reorder(district, median_price), y = median_price)) +
```

```{r}
# ── Select numeric variables only ─────────────────────────────────────────────
numeric_vars <- data %>%
  select(price, current_energy_efficiency, potential_energy_efficiency,
         heating_cost_current, heating_cost_potential,
         hot_water_cost_current, lighting_cost_current,
         total_floor_area, number_habitable_rooms,
         dist_to_tube_km, lat, long)

# ── Compute correlation matrix ────────────────────────────────────────────────
cor_matrix <- cor(numeric_vars, use = "complete.obs")

# ── Melt for ggplot using tidyr instead of reshape2 ──────────────────────────
cor_melted <- cor_matrix %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  rownames_to_column("Var1") %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(-Var1, names_to = "Var2", values_to = "value")

# ── Plot heatmap ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
p3a <- ggplot(cor_melted, aes(x = Var1, y = Var2, fill = value)) +
  geom_tile(colour = "white") +
  geom_text(aes(label = round(value, 2)), size = 3) +
  scale_fill_gradient2(low = "#D7191C", mid = "white", high = "#2C7BB6",
                       midpoint = 0, limits = c(-1, 1),
                       name = "Correlation") +
  labs(title = "Correlation Heatmap — Numeric Variables",
       x = "", y = "") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 9),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 9))

print(p3a)
ggsave("eda_plots/03a_correlation_heatmap.png", p3a, width=12, height=10, dpi=300)

cat("Section 3 complete ✓\n")
```

```{r}
# ── Load and filter to London only ───────────────────────────────────────────
boroughs <- st_read("boroughs.geojson") 

# Check what columns we have
names(boroughs)
cat("Total rows:", nrow(boroughs), "\n")
```
```{r}
# ── Filter to London boroughs using known London names ────────────────────────
london_names <- c("City of London", "Barking and Dagenham", "Barnet", "Bexley",
                  "Brent", "Bromley", "Camden", "Croydon", "Ealing", "Enfield",
                  "Greenwich", "Hackney", "Hammersmith and Fulham", "Haringey",
                  "Harrow", "Havering", "Hillingdon", "Hounslow", "Islington",
                  "Kensington and Chelsea", "Kingston upon Thames", "Lambeth",
                  "Lewisham", "Merton", "Newham", "Redbridge", "Richmond upon Thames",
                  "Southwark", "Sutton", "Tower Hamlets", "Waltham Forest",
                  "Wandsworth", "Westminster")

london_boroughs <- boroughs %>%
  filter(lad09nm %in% london_names)

cat("London boroughs:", nrow(london_boroughs), "\n")
print(london_boroughs$lad09nm)
```
```{r}
# ── Prepare district stats with manual name fix ───────────────────────────────
district_stats <- data %>%
  group_by(district) %>%
  summarise(
    median_price = median(price),
    median_epc   = median(current_energy_efficiency),
    n            = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    district = str_to_title(district),
    district = case_when(
      district == "Kingston Upon Thames"    ~ "Kingston upon Thames",
      district == "Richmond Upon Thames"    ~ "Richmond upon Thames",
      district == "Hammersmith And Fulham"  ~ "Hammersmith and Fulham",
      district == "Kensington And Chelsea"  ~ "Kensington and Chelsea",
      district == "City Of London"          ~ "City of London",
      district == "Barking And Dagenham"    ~ "Barking and Dagenham",
      district == "City Of Westminster"     ~ "Westminster",
      TRUE ~ district
    )
  )

# ── Join to shapefile ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
london_map <- london_boroughs %>%
  left_join(district_stats, by = c("lad09nm" = "district"))

# Check join
cat("Matched boroughs:", sum(!is.na(london_map$median_price)), "\n")
cat("Unmatched boroughs:", sum(is.na(london_map$median_price)), "\n")
```

```{r}
# Check variables we'll cluster on
data %>%
  select(current_energy_efficiency, potential_energy_efficiency,
         heating_cost_current, hot_water_cost_current,
         total_floor_area, number_habitable_rooms) %>%
  summary()
```
```{r}
# ── Step 1: Prepare and scale clustering variables ────────────────────────────
library(cluster)

set.seed(42)
sample_idx <- sample(nrow(cluster_vars), 50000)
cluster_sample <- cluster_vars[sample_idx, ]

# ── Step 2: Elbow method ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
wss <- sapply(1:10, function(k) {
  kmeans(cluster_sample, centers = k, nstart = 25, iter.max = 300)$tot.withinss
})

elbow_df <- data.frame(k = 1:10, wss = wss)

p5a <- ggplot(elbow_df, aes(x = k, y = wss)) +
  geom_line(colour = "#2C7BB6", linewidth = 1.2) +
  geom_point(colour = "#D7191C", size = 3) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 1:10) +
  labs(title = "Elbow Method — Optimal Number of Clusters",
       x = "Number of Clusters (k)", y = "Total Within-Cluster Sum of Squares")

# ── Step 3: Silhouette method — fix by using a small subsample ────────────────
set.seed(42)
sil_sample <- cluster_sample[sample(nrow(cluster_sample), 2000), ]

sil_scores <- sapply(2:8, function(k) {
  km    <- kmeans(sil_sample, centers = k, nstart = 25, iter.max = 300)
  diss  <- daisy(sil_sample)
  ss    <- silhouette(km$cluster, diss)
  mean(ss[, 3])
})

sil_df <- data.frame(k = 2:8, silhouette = sil_scores)

p5b <- ggplot(sil_df, aes(x = k, y = silhouette)) +
  geom_line(colour = "#1A9641", linewidth = 1.2) +
  geom_point(colour = "#D7191C", size = 3) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 2:8) +
  labs(title = "Silhouette Method — Optimal Number of Clusters",
       x = "Number of Clusters (k)", y = "Average Silhouette Score")

print(p5a)
print(p5b)

ggsave("eda_plots/05a_elbow.png",      p5a, width=10, height=6, dpi=300)
ggsave("eda_plots/05b_silhouette.png", p5b, width=10, height=6, dpi=300)

cat("WSS values:\n")
print(elbow_df)
cat("\nSilhouette scores:\n")
print(sil_df)
```
```{r}
# ── Step 4: Run K-means with k=4 on full dataset ──────────────────────────────
set.seed(42)
km4 <- kmeans(cluster_vars, centers = 4, nstart = 25, iter.max = 300)

# Assign cluster labels back to full dataset
data$cluster <- as.factor(km4$cluster)

cat("Cluster sizes:\n")
print(table(data$cluster))

# ── Step 5: Profile each cluster ─────────────────────────────────────────────
cluster_profile <- data %>%
  group_by(cluster) %>%
  summarise(
    n                          = n(),
    median_price               = median(price),
    mean_epc                   = round(mean(current_energy_efficiency), 1),
    mean_potential_epc         = round(mean(potential_energy_efficiency), 1),
    mean_heating_cost          = round(mean(heating_cost_current), 0),
    mean_hot_water_cost        = round(mean(hot_water_cost_current), 0),
    mean_floor_area            = round(mean(total_floor_area), 1),
    mean_rooms                 = round(mean(number_habitable_rooms), 1),
    pct_flat                   = round(mean(property_type == "Flat") * 100, 1),
    pct_terraced               = round(mean(property_type == "Terraced") * 100, 1),
    pct_detached               = round(mean(property_type == "Detached") * 100, 1),
    pct_new                    = round(mean(old_new == "New") * 100, 1),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

print(cluster_profile)

# ── Step 6: Price by cluster boxplot ─────────────────────────────────────────
p5c <- ggplot(data, aes(x = cluster, y = log(price), fill = cluster)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.alpha = 0.1, outlier.size = 0.5) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#2C7BB6", "#1A9641", "#D7191C", "#FF8C00")) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    breaks = log(c(100000, 250000, 500000, 1000000, 2000000)),
    labels = c("£100k", "£250k", "£500k", "£1m", "£2m")
  ) +
  labs(title = "Sale Price Distribution by Cluster",
       subtitle = "K-means clustering on physical and energy characteristics (k=4)",
       x = "Cluster", y = "Sale Price (log scale)") +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

# ── Step 7: PCA visualisation ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
set.seed(42)
pca_sample_idx <- sample(nrow(cluster_vars), 20000)
pca_result <- prcomp(cluster_vars[pca_sample_idx, ], scale. = FALSE)

pca_df <- data.frame(
  PC1     = pca_result$x[, 1],
  PC2     = pca_result$x[, 2],
  cluster = data$cluster[pca_sample_idx]
)

# Variance explained
var_explained <- round(summary(pca_result)$importance[2, 1:2] * 100, 1)

p5d <- ggplot(pca_df, aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, colour = cluster)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.3, size = 0.8) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c("#2C7BB6", "#1A9641", "#D7191C", "#FF8C00")) +
  labs(title = "PCA Projection of K-means Clusters (k=4)",
       subtitle = "Sample of 20,000 properties",
       x = paste0("PC1 (", var_explained[1], "% variance)"),
       y = paste0("PC2 (", var_explained[2], "% variance)"),
       colour = "Cluster")

print(p5c)
print(p5d)

ggsave("eda_plots/05c_cluster_price.png", p5c, width=10, height=7, dpi=300)
ggsave("eda_plots/05d_cluster_pca.png",   p5d, width=10, height=7, dpi=300)

cat("\nSection 5 complete ✓\n")
```
